work_block.X: ARC-AGI-3 official pinned Notebook, its regular-run parquet, two accepted historical submissions, two failed current submissions, and the generated GenericAGIRuntime Notebook.
work_block.R: Compare only the accepted Notebook/output contract and lifecycle. Historical runtime duration and score are not used to infer undocumented limits or to select the current runtime policy.
work_block.Mc: Accept the correction locally only when the generated Notebook has the official four-code-cell order, requires the official offline wheels whenever the bundle is mounted and fails if they are absent during rerun, keeps competition and placeholder paths separate, emits the exact official placeholder row and columns, leaves competition output to the gateway, adds no runtime limit, and has no secret or submission side effect.
non_goals: Do not infer a limit shorter than the official nine-hour Notebook limit.
Do not change the 128-action GenericAGIRuntime budget.
Do not restore task/game/level routing, replay, fixed action sequences, literal coordinates, Teacher, source state, or hidden state.
Do not perform another competition submission in this work block.
work_block.evidence_boundary: The accepted submission records expose status, score, file name, and collected bytes but not their private rerun logs or original private Notebook source. The repository commit immediately following those submissions preserves the same official bootstrap and placeholder contract, but is not claimed to be byte-identical to the submitted private Notebook.
work_block.falsification_condition: A regular Kaggle version generated from the corrected source fails to produce the exact official placeholder contract, or a later authorized competition rerun still returns zero collected bytes with the corrected contract.
work_block.regression_line: GenericAGIRuntime package digest and 128-action budget remain unchanged; only the Kaggle Notebook transport/placeholder contract and its validator change.

official_pinned_notebook.competition_output_owner: Kaggle ARC-AGI-3 gateway after scorecard closure

accepted_submission_evidence_role: End-to-end historical acceptance evidence only. These records do not expose the private Notebook source or rerun logs and therefore do not define exact format details or any runtime limit.

corrective_regular_run_evidence.failure: The official offline wheel directory was absent during the normal saved-version run.

official_pinned_notebook_contract.cell_layout: four code cells: install, agent payload, competition runner, non-rerun placeholder

failed_version_5.cell_layout: markdown plus three code cells; competition and placeholder paths merged

corrected_version_7.cell_layout: four code cells: install, payload, competition runner, non-rerun placeholder
corrected_version_7.wheel_install: install from the official offline bundle when mounted; fail closed if the bundle is absent during competition rerun; allow normal-run placeholder verification when Kaggle does not mount the bundle

findings.reason_single_root_not_proven: Kaggle did not expose private rerun logs or a traceback for either zero-byte failure.
findings.duration_basis: The official code requirements publish a nine-hour CPU/GPU Notebook limit; no shorter limit was found and failure elapsed time is not used as evidence.
findings.most_specific_proven_failure_boundary: The failed versions did not yield a collectible gateway result and their saved regular-run placeholder/Notebook contract differed from the official accepted contract.
findings.next_gate: Keep actual competition submission suspended until the user explicitly authorizes version 7. A successful competition rerun with nonzero collected bytes is still required to prove that the two prior zero-byte system errors were caused by the corrected format mismatch.
